verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that 'Pre-Merge Checks' exist and tie into the blocking request-changes workflow (coderabbit-docs-47, coderabbit-supp-4). Path instructions let you write natural-language guidance such as test-coverage requirements or documentation clarity rules (coderabbit-docs-8, coderabbit-docs-48), and these are applied in reviews that run automatically on every PR (coderabbit-docs-39, coderabbit-docs-21). However, no evidence documents defining custom plain-language pre-merge checks as pass/fail gates; the pieces are only implied by combining review instructions with the request-changes workflow. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of user-defined natural-language pre-merge checks and their pass/fail semantics, examples like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths' as checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
